plan: Trim QQQI to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the single-name mandate.
Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU) to zero for capital preservation.

conservative.read: This conservative plan targets a modest ~1.5%/month return, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces leverage and high-beta exposure, aiming for lower drawdown risk. Expect slower growth but increased stability.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to meet the single-name mandate.
Reduce exposure to leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU, PLTU) to small positions.
Buy ZS at 4% of the book, leveraging its strong scanner setup and high risk/reward.
This plan balances risk and growth by reducing overall leverage while adding a high-quality growth name.
It aims for a more diversified and risk-managed portfolio.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5%/month, aiming for risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration, blending broad index with quality tech. Expect moderate growth with controlled drawdown potential.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to meet the single-name mandate.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4%/month, aiming for stretched growth. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-beta tech. Be aware of substantially higher drawdown risk and the daily decay/rebalancing of leveraged products.

plan: Add to QQQI, increasing its allocation to 30% for enhanced income generation.
